lines: Ha, nice to meet you, everyone! I'm Super Sonico, and today, please take care of me!
For a day of Taimanin gravure work, the idol's greeting made both the boys and the girls go wild when they arrived at Gosha.
(So that's the vocalist of "First Cosmic Speed", Super Sonico-chan... lucky!)
I'm not really up on trends, but I definitely knew about the popular girl.
She's the guitarist‑vocalist of the girls' band "First Cosmic Speed" and a gravure idol.
She's also appearing in anime and games, expanding her stage day by day—truly a rising star idol.
Sonico-chan, do a cute pose for us!
Huh, a cute pose? Um... how about this?
The students' roar‑like cheers echoed so loudly the ground seemed to shake.
Everyone is a martial artist who uses some kind of ability and has been training hard.
Their voices were so huge they could rival any sports‑club, ripping through the air.
Yet Sonico showed no sign of fear, smiling happily at the fans' cheers, bowing her head politely to the praise.
(Even though she's popular, she doesn't act like a diva... could she be a saint?)
The Sonico chants swelled, and she looked like she might burst into tears, truly moved.
Trying to calm Sonico—or rather the atmosphere—the teacher clapped his hands.
Thank you all for taking on a day of Taimanin work today, we truly appreciate it. We'll do the full‑blown shoot later—
First, let's try some proper Taimanin‑style training and see how that looks on camera.
Ah, yes, I understand. Since I'm both body and soul a Taimanin today, please train me hard.
It was probably a scripted progression arranged with the agency.
With a smooth response, the set for filming was prepared.
Then—what are you all watching? Everyone, you’ll be doing it too, it’s training.
As the students-turned-audience were called out, boos of resentment erupted.
Even if I silenced them with skill, the teacher’s eyes swept around.
And—then it stopped dead in front of me.
Then—shall we have Fuuma as Sonico’s partner?
The sudden naming, especially as a training partner, sent screams and cries roaring from the crowd.
Teacher, I! I think I’m the best! My practical scores are higher!
He’s supposed to be Sonico’s opponent!
I think a girl is more suitable than a boy! Like me! *slurp*…
I’m also more than happy, *pant pant*!
(You guys are the only ones unfit!)
While I was making mental retorts, the teacher silenced each of them one by one, guided Sonico, and led her to me.
He’s Fuuma. He’s an excellent kid who also commands a special unit, so rest assured.
I was nervous, completely out of character.
I greeted with a hoarse voice from my strained throat, coughing involuntarily, my ears burning.
Seeing me like that, Sonico softened her slightly tense expression with a small smile and bowed her head.
Super Sonico here! Training partner, please take care of me, Fuuma‑san!
Likewise, please take care of me.
The super idol standing before me, her ever‑humble attitude, gradually eased my tension.
Alright, let's start training. First, we'll begin with a thrust.
This. This mock sword—it's also called a replica blade—but we'll train by thrusting at a target with it. Think of it like kendo, basically.
I‑I see... Wait, aren't we supposed to wear armor?
Sonico took the mock sword, stared at it intently, then glanced around as if she’d just realized something.
Indeed, kendo requires armor, but there’s no such thing for Taimanin training.
Well, you won’t get seriously hurt. Still, if you’re hesitant to hit me… just aim at this instead.
I also took a mock sword and slipped it straight in front of Sonico.
So I just strike that sword? Got it, I’ll try—Eii!
A crisp clank rang out as the mock blade clumsily collided.
It wasn’t a swing meant to cut an opponent, but a swing treating the sword like a blunt weapon.
It wasn’t proper training, yet the amateur’s earnest expression and her determined thrusts shone brightly.
Yeah, good, good. You’ve got a clear target.
Even though I’m not great at combat, I’m still a Taimanin at heart.
I deftly deflected her amateur thrusts, careful not to injure either of us, while praising the strong points of her movements.
Sonico thanked me sincerely and smiled, showing a pure, delicate side never seen at Gosha Academy.
(She lives in a different world than I do… huh?)
As I watched her dazzlingly, feeling both drawn to her and a bit distant, I suddenly realized something.
While placating her bewildered self, my eyes fixed on her cleavage.
No, regarding sheer size, even Gosha and my classmates, seniors, teachers—all have plenty of members, and the shapes and atmospheres vary widely.
Nevertheless, when it comes to shaking during training or the like, I have no luxury to watch that.
If I let even a hint of breast bounce distract me, my consciousness would instantly slip away.
Ta! Ah, that was a nice sound just now!
Yes, that was great... With that feeling, one more, please.
I asked her to reenact the movement, and as the sword‑play novice gravure idol swung, I thoroughly enjoyed watching her breasts sway.
She kicked the ground powerfully and swung her arms, each time her huge breasts bounced with a thump, shaking provocatively, stoking my desire.
...Alright, that'll be enough for practice. Next, let's make it a bit harder.
Seeking the next scene, I told her what to do next.
She probably thought it was a break, breathing heavily, answering with a confused look while drawing her sword.
(Sorry, Sonico... but I want to see more, that potential!)
If she makes bigger movements, how will the sway change—.
I'll swing the sword at regular intervals; watch it and aim for where it moves. Let's do twenty and then take a break.
She nodded to my words, obediently stepping forward, leaping to strike with her sword.
Thanks to the footwork and body motion, her breasts rippled not only up and down but also side to side, diagonally, even tracing circles as they danced.
I could tell my expression had completely relaxed, even though nobody was watching.
Moreover, the beast inside me was craving another mishap.
(If Sonico fell here... maybe I could score a lucky pervert?)
Last five—I'll change the pattern a bit. If I can hit all five correctly, it's over.
Ueee— with this... no, yes! I'll do my best... Yaaah!
Feeling guilty about her honest behavior, I altered the sword's trajectory randomly, confusing her steps.
Considering the fatigue so far, her legs should trip any moment now.
(...no, no, don't get the wrong idea. This is just training... If she falls, I'll just help her up...)
While guiding her movements, I focused on watching her closely, ready for her to collapse at any time.
(...Whoa, damn! Looking closely, her sweat is... and wow, she smells amazing—)
Her sweat soaked into her outfit, making it cling to her body.
It's a shame it's not see-through, but the sweat-soaked costume steamed with her body heat, and the scent drifted softly.
A sweet‑tart sweat aroma, the soft feminine fragrance, and hints of shampoo and soap—
I narrowed my eyes and sniffed, and the moment I looked away—
The missed slash bounced up right after the swing and struck my jaw with an uppercut motion.
The miss‑thrown blade she raised in panic turned into a sharp blow that seemed to cut my consciousness cleanly.
I could hear those guys' jeers, but as my consciousness faded, I thought—.
Even taking this shame, the view was so wonderful I could savor it to the point of getting change back—so they say.
I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Are you injured?! Fuuma-san! Fuuma-san!!
(No... it's me who should say... I'm really sorry...)
